title: QA-triage labeled corpus (issue #290)
description: Shape of a labeled regression corpus for Human Intervention Rate and Critical Defect Escape measurement. See docs/qa-triage-corpus.md for the label definitions and the collection procedure.

language_pair.description: Language pair of the corpus, e.g. ja->zh-Hans.

source_task.description: Redacted task id when the sample was drawn from a real task; null for synthetic corpora. Never an app-data task id.

generated.description: True when all text is authored for the fixture rather than exported from a task.

note.description: Provenance note; required by convention for synthetic corpora (see the corpus README).

segment_id.description: Segment index within the corpus; labels reference it.

document.description: Document id within the corpus; synthetic ids only.

finding_id.description: The finding this label annotates. null means the point of the sample is that NO finding was raised on that segment.

segment_id.description: Must reference a segment in the same corpus.

label.description: The four ground-truth labels; a corpus must contain all four (issue #290).

defect_class.description: Reuses the class names already injected by scripts/review_defect_recall.py, plus translation_completion and source_residue.

note.description: Why this is an error, or why keeping it is legitimate.

deterministic_expected.description: Reused from scripts/review_defect_recall.py: whether the deterministic layer is expected to catch this defect.
